instruction: Turn towards a large wooden manel, go forward through a doorway and continue down a red carpet between rope barriers until you reach the next doorway, facing a large bed,and stop.

steps.thought: I see the red carpet leading straight to a doorway ahead. I'll advance along the carpet toward it.
I'm aligned with the red carpet leading to the doorway ahead; continue forward along it.
I'm aligned with the red carpet leading through the doorway ahead. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm aligned with the doorway and red carpet ahead; continue forward along the carpet toward the next doorway.
I've passed through the first doorway and am on the red carpet. I need to continue forward along the carpet toward the next doorway.
I've passed through the first doorway and am on the red carpet. I need to continue down the carpet to the next doorway where a large bed should be visible ahead.
I've passed through the first doorway and am on the red carpet between rope barriers. The next doorway appears to be the dark opening on the left; I'll advance along the carpet and aim for it.
I'm on the red carpet between rope barriers. The next doorway is ahead-left, with what looks like a bed beyond it. I'll turn left to align and advance.
I'm on the red carpet between rope barriers; the next doorway is ahead-left, with a large bed visible through it. I'll advance toward it and re-observe.
I'm on the red carpet facing the doorway ahead; the next room beyond contains furniture. I'll advance through the doorway and look for the large bed.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway ahead; continue advancing through it.
I'm facing a wooden panel wall; the red carpet and doorway are to my left. I need to turn left and proceed through the doorway along the red carpet.
I'm beside a large wooden structure with the red carpet visible ahead through the opening. I'll turn right to align with the carpet and move forward.

I appear to have passed the red carpet area and entered a room with a table and chairs; the red carpet was visible behind me earlier. I need to turn back toward the red carpet and find the next doorway with the large bed.
I've drifted too close to the wooden furniture on my right; the open room with the red carpet lies to my left. I'll turn left to re-face the room before moving.
The red carpet leads through a doorway ahead; I should advance along it toward the next doorway.
The red carpet leads through the doorway ahead; I should advance along it toward the next doorway.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the ornate doorway ahead; the carpet continues through it, so I should keep advancing along it.
I'm on the red carpet heading through the doorway into the red-walled room. Continue forward along the carpet toward the next doorway.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the far doorway; the bed should be beyond it. Continue advancing along the carpet.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the far doorway; continue forward along the carpet.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway ahead; the bed should be visible through it. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway ahead; continue forward along the carpet.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway ahead; the bed should be beyond it. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm beside the large wooden mantel; the doorway with the red carpet is ahead-right. I'll turn right to align with the doorway before moving.
I'm on the red carpet facing the next doorway ahead. Continue forward along the carpet toward it.
I'm aligned with the red carpet leading through the doorway ahead. Continue advancing along the carpet toward the next doorway.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the next doorway visible ahead. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm passing through the doorway onto the red carpet; the next room with the bed is visible ahead. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the far doorway where a bed is visible. Continue forward along the carpet, re-aiming slightly left to stay centered.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the far doorway where a bed is visible. I should continue forward along the carpet, checking alignment as I go.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the far doorway where a bed is visible. I should continue forward along the carpet, checking alignment as I go.
The red carpet runs ahead-left toward a doorway through which a bed is visible. I'll turn left to align with the carpet and then advance toward that doorway.
I'm aligned with the red carpet leading to the doorway where a large bed is visible beyond. I'll advance along the carpet toward that doorway.
The red carpet runs straight ahead to a doorway, and a large bed is visible through it. I'll advance along the carpet toward that doorway.
I'm at the doorway with the red carpet ahead and the large bed visible through the next doorway. I'll advance a few steps along the carpet toward it, then stop.
I'm at the doorway with the red carpet leading ahead to the next doorway where a large bed is visible. I'll advance along the carpet toward that doorway.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway with the large bed visible beyond. Continue forward along the carpet.
The red carpet leads through the doorway straight to the large bed ahead. I'm close to the doorway; a couple of forward steps should put me at the next doorway facing the bed, then I stop.
